title: Reduce exact Fano census memory with compact singleton storage
body:
The exact Fano census allocates a member list and tuple for almost every one of its 1.38 million singleton product classes. This opt-in package stores one base-n word code per singleton and allocates lists only for actual collisions, preserving full matrix keys, arbitrary class sizes, every ordered relator pair and the complete original replay.

Four alternating fresh-process repetitions on CPython 3.12.15 measured mean peak RSS **392.4 → 223.8 MiB (43.0% lower)** with canonical multiplication, and **380.3 → 211.4 MiB (44.4% lower)** when composed with Charan's pinned PR3219 row tables. Mean wall times were 29.12 → 27.97 seconds and 11.65 → 10.32 seconds. Timing ranges overlap for the row-table pair; these are descriptive shared-host measurements. All 16 complete receipts and full census digests match. Raw samples, commands, source hashes and ranges are retained.

Validation: the complete registered CPython 3.12.15 replay passes, including all four complete verifier modes and 17 isolated optimized oracle, mutation, authentication, restoration and benchmark controls. The controls also pass normally. Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/fano-census-compact-storage
```

This is verifier engineering, with no new mathematical result or supplier admission. Canonical multiplication/packing and every original source/Fano/control check remain unchanged in the core pair. The optional comparison retains PR3219's exact pending source and credit; baseline/compact workers do not read it. No canonical verifier, selected record or frozen source changes. Selected cold replay and native/all-width obligations are outside scope.

Coordination: [Discussion3062 comment19004550](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3062#discussioncomment-19004550). Base canonical main/fork `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`, priority revision 6. Retain Sudarsh Chaturvedi/PR3168, Gonzalo Mier/PR3097, Charan/PR3219 (`209d20d9da025c90110465f9a1f18186a6160147`) and the full chart-swap/selected-source lineage in the package. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; separate AI executions are not independent human review. Apache-2.0.
